ra-component-button-primary-background-d.$description: Component contract: button primary background default.

ra-component-button-primary-content-defa.$description: Component contract: button primary content default.

ra-component-button-secondary-background.$description: Component contract: button secondary background default.

ra-component-button-secondary-content-de.$description: Component contract: button secondary content default.

ra-component-button-secondary-border-def.$description: Component contract: button secondary border default.

ra-component-button-secondary-background.$description: Component contract: button secondary background hover.

ra-component-button-ghost-background-hov.$description: Component contract: button ghost background hover.

ra-icon-content.$description: Monochrome icon content. Standard context shown; Primary uses action-on-primary, Accent content-on-dark-accent, Disabled text-muted.

ra-core-space-0.$description: No gap. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-1.$description: Micro detail (4). 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-2.$description: Compact content gaps; button icon-label gap; control vertical padding. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-3.$description: Small-button horizontal padding; field icon gap. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-4.$description: Component internal padding; medium-button horizontal padding. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-5.$description: Large-button horizontal padding. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-6.$description: Section padding inside panels. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-8.$description: Major group separation. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-10.$description: Large group separation. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-12.$description: Page-level spacing starts here. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-16.$description: Page rhythm. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-20.$description: Hero and page rhythm. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-space-24.$description: Largest page rhythm step. 4pt grid; never use in-between values.

ra-core-radius-sm.$description: Tooltips, compact chips, focus outline on checkboxes.

ra-core-radius-lg.$description: Large cards and containers; focus outline around md controls.

ra-elevation-0.$description: Flush surfaces: canvas-level content and inset regions.

ra-core-size-control-sm.$description: Dense web control or compact visual treatment. Not a standalone iOS hit target.

ra-core-size-control-md.$description: Default primary control size: approximately 44px on web and the minimum iOS interaction target.

ra-core-size-interaction-min.$description: Minimum 44×44 interaction bounds for iOS and a strong target for primary web controls.

ra-core-size-control-lg.$description: Comfortable cross-platform control size for touch-forward interfaces.

ra-component-button-radius.$description: Component contract: button radius. Aliases ra-core-radius-md.

ra-component-button-height-web-md.$description: Component contract: button height web-md. Aliases ra-core-size-control-md.

ra-component-button-height-web-lg.$description: Component contract: button height web-lg. Aliases ra-core-size-control-lg.

ra-component-button-height-ios-md.$description: Component contract: button height ios-md. Aliases ra-core-size-interaction-min.

ra-component-button-height-ios-lg.$description: Component contract: button height ios-lg. Aliases ra-core-size-control-lg.

ra-component-field-radius.$description: Component contract: field radius. Aliases ra-core-radius-md.

ra-component-status-radius.$description: Component contract: status radius. Aliases ra-core-radius-pill.

ra-core-size-control-xs.$description: Compact visual control. Pair with a larger interaction target when touch-operated.

ra-core-stroke-1.$description: Default hairline for field and control outlines.

ra-core-stroke-2.$description: 1px: field and control outlines. 2px: focus rings, error/selected borders, secondary buttons.

ra-core-motion-fast.$description: Selections, buttons, direct manipulation; CUE, LOCK.

ra-core-motion-hero.$description: Rare branded or scene-level transitions; POSSESS.

ra-semantic-color-background-canvas.$description: Screen canvas: the ground every surface sits on.

ra-semantic-color-background-subtle.$description: Recessed regions, read-only and disabled field fills, tooltips.

ra-semantic-color-background-surface.$description: Default content surface: cards, fields, panels on the canvas.

ra-semantic-color-background-surface-rai.$description: Elevated content: secondary buttons, hovered fields, raised cards.

ra-semantic-color-background-interactive.$description: Control containers: pressed secondary and ghost states, neutral tags, hovered switch tracks.

ra-semantic-color-text-primary.$description: Key content and labels on canvas, surface and surface-raised (17.57:1 on canvas in Dark, 14.67:1 in Light).

ra-semantic-color-text-secondary.$description: Supporting copy, helper text and placeholders on surface (9.02:1 Dark, 10.88:1 Light).

ra-semantic-color-text-muted.$description: Lowest-emphasis text and disabled labels on surface (4.56:1 Dark, 5.08:1 Light). Never smaller than 12px.

ra-semantic-color-border-default.$description: Decorative separators only. Not an essential boundary.

ra-semantic-color-border-subtle.$description: Quiet decorative dividers and disabled outlines.

ra-semantic-color-action-primary.$description: Toxic primary action fill: primary buttons, checked checkboxes, on switches. Pair with action-on-primary.

ra-semantic-color-focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset outside the control. Keep distinct from selection.

ra-semantic-color-status-success.$description: Completed outcome indicator (dot, border, icon). Always with a label.

ra-semantic-color-status-warning.$description: Attention-required indicator. Always with a label.

ra-semantic-color-status-danger.$description: Failure or destructive-risk indicator and error field borders. Use text-danger for copy.

ra-semantic-color-mutation-live.$description: Mutation Layer: active performance. Never infer readiness from green alone.

ra-semantic-color-text-inverse.$description: Text on live/inverted fills such as feedback-live-surface.

ra-semantic-color-text-link.$description: Inline links on canvas and surface.

ra-semantic-color-border-strong.$description: Essential control boundaries: fields, checkboxes, radios, switch tracks, secondary buttons (3.01:1 Dark, 3.38:1 Light on surface).

ra-semantic-color-border-interactive.$description: Selected or interactive outlines (selected icon buttons).

ra-semantic-color-action-primary-pressed.$description: Primary action pressed and selected fill.

ra-semantic-color-overlay-scrim.$description: Dims content behind dialogs and sheets (apply with opacity over real content).

ra-semantic-color-overlay-surface.$description: Foreground surface for overlays, menus and popovers.

ra-semantic-color-icon-interactive.$description: Actionable icons; keep the accessible name.

ra-semantic-color-effect-graphic-shadow.$description: Hard comic shadow ink for stickers, badges and posters; not functional elevation.

ra-semantic-color-effect-toxic-glow-subt.$description: Glow for meaningful Connected, Live or Active states; never replaces focus or labels.

ra-semantic-color-effect-toxic-glow-medi.$description: Emphatic glow for one high-priority state per view.

ra-semantic-color-effect-magenta-glow-su.$description: Glow for Selected state or singular branded emphasis.

ra-semantic-color-effect-print-offset.$description: Print-registration offset for display type and decorative graphics only.

ra-semantic-color-action-destructive-def.$description: Destructive button fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-content-on-dark-accent.$description: Invariant light content on deliberately dark accent fills (destructive, expressive, strong accents) in both themes.

ra-semantic-color-action-expressive-hove.$description: Expressive accent hover (decorative use; not a text ground).

ra-semantic-color-accent-selected-strong.$description: Magenta tag fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-accent-creative-strong.$description: Purple tag fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-accent-special-strong.$description: Orange tag fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-accent-information-str.$description: Information tag fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-accent-danger-strong.$description: Danger tag fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-semantic-color-action-expressive-defa.$description: Brand / Expressive button fill; pair with content-on-dark-accent.

ra-color-text-danger.$description: Readable error copy on canvas or surface. Use status-danger for indicators, not text.

ra-color-feedback-live-surface.$description: Live feedback background; pair with text-inverse. Distinct from mutation-live.

ra-semantic-color-android-state-text-pri.$description: Android state-layer overlay (text-primary at 8%). Android adapter only.
Android state-layer overlay (text-primary at 10%). Android adapter only.

Android state-layer overlay (action-on-primary at 10%). Android adapter only.

ra-semantic-color-android-state-backgrou.$description: Android state-layer overlay (background-surface at 10%). Android adapter only.

ra-elevation-1.$description: Raised cards and resting floating controls. Pair with a surface or border change.

ra-elevation-2.$description: Menus, popovers, sheets and active floating controls.

ra-effect-toxic-glow-subtle.$description: Limited Live, Connected or Active accent; never the only cue.

ra-effect-toxic-glow-medium.$description: One high-priority Live indicator or hero action per view.

ra-effect-magenta-glow-subtle.$description: Selected state or singular branded emphasis, with a non-color cue.

ra-effect-print-offset.$description: Display type, labels, stamps and posters. Never body copy or controls.
